about_the_game:
Once you find yourself all alone in the middle of an unexplored valley, you are looking for any way to get out of it. Explore, create things, communicate with tribes and solve all the mysteries of this strange place. Thousands of enemies stand in your way, whether you can crush them is up to you.



In Demo you can explore the essence of Forsaken Valley, dessert, quarry and more to look to reveal the secret of this place. 3 tribes will help you, and even may God creatures - but you have still obstacles to overcome. Unique styles and different approaches to compete would suit any kind of player in this awesome journey. 

Available in Demo:

  • 4 basic locations.

  • 8 different enemies to fight.

  • 3 tribes to trade

  • 2 mini-bosses

  • and more to explore...

COLLECT ITEMS

Find items to create immersive ways to destroy enemies and find a way out of this place in the end. Dozens of approaches - up to you which one to choose.

EXPLORE THE WORLD

7 different areas to explore, 24 monsters to destroy and 4 bosses to banish. It is up to you how will you proceed - but your enemies are getting stronger each time you slay them. 

CREATE SOMETHING SPECIAL

Astonishing amount of weapons, amulets, charms and more to create and develop. Communicate with Tribes - they will help you with surviving and unveiling the mysteries of the Forsaken Valley.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 7700 or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1080 or similar
  • Additional Notes: Any PC should run this game.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 7700 or similar
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 2060 or similar
  • Additional Notes: Any PC should run this game.
